text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to inquire about hiring the Marlowe for a corporate event, for which we would greatly appreciate your assistance. We would like to arrange for the vehicle to be collected from your garage on Thu 8 Apr 2027 at 12:00 and returned to your garage on Saturday 10 April 2027 at 12 pm. Additionally, we would like the Marlowe to be made available to us with a chauffeur. 

Please let me know if this is feasible and we will be in touch to discuss further details.

Thank you for your time and consideration,
Imogen Thistlewood
+70 706 203 5922
